row.evidence: Anaplan publishes no prices (anaplan.com/pricing redirects to a contact form), and Anapedia documents a SCIM 2.0 API ("uses version 2.0 of the SCIM standard") as an alternative to Centralized Identity Management for any tenant's User Admin.
row.notes: New row. Anaplan sells only by quote: /pricing redirects to the contact form and no editions or prices are public (Anapedia mentions editions only for audit-log retention), so SCIM, like everything else, sits behind Contact Sales; no page says SCIM needs a particular edition or add-on, hence confidence low. SCIM 2.0 at https://api.anaplan.com/scim/1/0/v2 covers Users only (no Groups resource; workspace access is pushed as entitlements), with Basic auth, AnaplanAuthToken or API keys (max 365 days) for a non-SSO User Admin. Deprovisioning is active=false (disable; frees the licence); DELETE is not supported. Okta's catalogue app is SAML/SWA only and Entra's gallery app is SSO only, so both provision through a custom app against the generic endpoint; Anaplan says it tested thoroughly with Okta. Visiting users are out of scope for SCIM. Non-SCIM user management: Administration API CSV import/export of users and licences; Audit API needs Audit enabled.

plans.name: Anaplan platform (quote only)
plans.notes: No public tier table. Anapedia says audit-log retention is 30 or 90 days 'depending on your edition', so editions exist but are not published.

auth.token_source: Basic auth of a non-SSO User Admin, an AnaplanAuthToken from the authentication service, or an API key (Administration > Security settings) sent as Bearer
auth.token_expiry: API keys: admin-set expiry, maximum 365 days; no rotation
auth.notes: Docs recommend a non-SSO account with the USER_ADMIN role; SCIM works without SSO configured. Key rotation isn't supported (revoke, delete and recreate).

endpoints.notes: Users is the only resource; workspace access is managed through the entitlements attribute, not Groups.

operations.notes: PATCH requires a path on every operation. Reactivation is active=true (enable).

deprovision.data_retained: User is disabled and can no longer log in via basic auth or SSO; the account remains and can be re-enabled.

filtering.notes: Operators eq, ne, pr, gt, ge, lt, le; co/sw/ew, complex attribute filters and POST /.search are not supported.

custom.how: Only workspace entitlements are supported beyond core attributes.

attributes.notes: name.formatted and displayName are accepted but not stored or searchable. Up to 50 workspaces per call.

roles.notes: Workspace is the only entitlement; roles are assigned in Administration.

limitations.text: SCIM does not support visiting users.
DELETE is not supported (501); deprovision by setting active false.
Entitlement updates are not atomic; user data may save while entitlements fail (207 partial success).
Maximum 50 workspaces per call and 100 users per GET page.
Anaplan says it tested thoroughly only with Okta; other IdPs connect via API keys.

endpoints.purpose: Create or update users (and licences) from a CSV upload, max 500 rows
Export users as CSV (username, first name, last name, licenses)

audit_log_api.plan: Audit enabled in tenant (retention 30 or 90 days by edition)

limitations.text: The Integration API v2.0 is for model data and actions, not user administration.

user_api.notes: Separate Financial Consolidation API has its own user and role endpoints for that product only (not recorded).

okta.notes: OIN page marks only SAML and SWA as checked (read from page markup). Anaplan's SCIM guide has admins create a separate Okta app with SCIM provisioning against the generic endpoint.

entra.notes: Gallery tutorial covers SSO only; Anaplan docs say Azure can use the SCIM API with API keys.

fallbacks.other_sync: Administration API bulk CSV import/export; Centralized Identity Management in the Administration console
